brief: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.

requirements.evidence: Original base piece:0,0,0;full kept. Two more full bases were added (piece:1,-1,0 and piece:2,-1,0) because a bay can only be fitted with three bases around it. The brief did not ask for these.

requirements.requirement: A bay bin filling one half of a cell
requirements.evidence: bay:0#1,0#bay1, a half bay tray (hex-bin-bay-n-half-solid). It fills half of the empty spot at (1,0,0) and is bolted to all three bases. It does not sit inside a base's own cell; a bay can't go there.
check_build found no rule errors and meshClash is clear. The only notes are about open faces that could take caps.

finish.summary: Half bay tray fitted at (1,0,0), held by three full bases at (0,0), (1,-1) and (2,-1). Two bases were added beyond the brief because a bay needs three.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
